1→// TranslatorsCard.Build.cs
     2→// Build configuration for the TranslatorsCard game module.
     3→//
     4→// Phase 4: Game flow logic migrated to TranslatorsBridgeRuntime plugin.
     5→// This module now depends on the plugin for BridgeTypes.h and the subsystem.
     6→// BridgeComponent is a thin relay to UTranslatorsBridgeSubsystem.
     7→
     8→using UnrealBuildTool;
     9→
    10→public class TranslatorsCard : ModuleRules
    11→{
    12→    public TranslatorsCard(ReadOnlyTargetRules Target) : base(Target)
    13→    {
    14→        PCHUsage = PCHUsageMode.UseExplicitOrSharedPCHs;
    15→
    16→        // Core modules
    17→        PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
    18→        {
    19→            "Core",
    20→            "CoreUObject",
    21→            "Engine",
    22→            "InputCore"
    23→        });
    24→
    25→        // TranslatorsBridge plugin — subsystem, BridgeTypes, delegates
    26→        PublicDependencyModuleNames.Add("TranslatorsBridgeRuntime");
    27→
    28→        // Editor-only features
    29→        // DirectoryWatcher migrated to TranslatorsBridgeEditor plugin module (Phase 3).
    30→        if (Target.bBuildEditor)
    31→        {
    32→            // USD Stage Actor support (editor-only)
    33→            // Note: USDA text parsing works without this module
    34→            // This is only needed for live USD Stage manipulation
    35→            PrivateDefinitions.Add("WITH_USD_SUPPORT=1");
    36→
    37→            // Remote Control API (editor-only)
    38→            // Enables REST API on localhost:30010 for external tool access
    39→            PrivateDependencyModuleNames.Add("RemoteControl");
    40→        }
    41→
    42→        // UMG / Slate UI support (required for question display widgets)
    43→        PrivateDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[]
    44→        {
    45→            "Slate",
    46→            "SlateCore",
    47→            "UMG",
    48→            "EnhancedInput"
    49→        });
    50→
    51→        // Enable IWYU (Include What You Use)
    52→        IWYUSupport = IWYUSupport.Full;
    53→
    54→        // Bridge version (matches plugin — defined in TranslatorsBridgeRuntime.Build.cs)
    55→        // Kept here for legacy references; canonical version is BRIDGE_VERSION from the plugin.
    56→
    57→        // Ensure generated headers are available
    58→        PublicIncludePaths.Add(ModuleDirectory);
    59→        PrivateIncludePaths.Add(ModuleDirectory + "/UI");
    60→    }
    61→}
